versions.name: Climbing
versions.description: Tie the knots a climber's life hangs on, inspect and retire rope, belay both climbers and rappellers, then climb three routes and rappel three more using the verbal signals that keep a team in sync.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
